title: My Family and Our Things
instructions: 阅读短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A. My name is Li Wei. I am a student. This is my family. We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me. We are in Beijing. Our home is small but nice.

B. My father is a teacher. He has a new phone. My mother is a nurse. She has two bags. My sister is ten. She has three books. They are on her desk. I have one bike. It is blue.

C. We have a cat. Its name is Mimi. Mimi has four small toys. They are under the chair. We are happy. We love our family.

原文说“She has two bags”，意思是“她有两个包”。

questions.prompt: 李伟的自行车是什么颜色的？请用原文中的一个词填空。
questions.explanation: 原文说“It is blue”，意思是“它是蓝色的”。
questions.evidence: I have one bike. It is blue.

questions.explanation: 原文说“Its name is Mimi”，意思是“它的名字是Mimi”。
原文说“They are under the chair”，意思是“它们在椅子下面”。
原文说“My sister is ten”，意思是“我妹妹十岁”。

grammar.title: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 我们用 we 表示“我们”，they 表示“他们/它们”。be 动词用 are，例如“We are four people.”。名词变复数一般加 -s，例如 bag → bags。my 表示“我的”，your 表示“你的”，his 表示“他的”，her 表示“她的”。have 用于 I/you/we/they，has 用于 he/she/it，例如“He has a new phone.”。
grammar.example: We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me.

questions.explanation: 主语是 she，动词用 has。
